notes.title: Update 0.2.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here’s the latest update for Monster Care Simulator! This version introduces gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and some balance tweaks.

[b][h1][h2]Changelog[/h2][/h1][/b]

[h2]Improvements & Adjustments :hammer_and_wrench:[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay & Interactions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Food items are no longer pushed by players like a ball.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface & Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved input helper: Now contextually displays controls
[/list].
[h3]Monster Care & Environment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added happiness bar to track monster mood.
[*] Egg now appear when monsters are happy (one per save).
[*] Bill mecanic modified with a new cash register
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes :bug:[/h2]
[h3]Lighting & Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked quality lighting settings for better visuals.
[*] Adjusted lamp lighting and center light effects.
[*] Improved fire and ice visual effects.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay & Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where apples would fall through the ground.
[*] Fixed a soft lock caused by guidance popups when petting a monster.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing players from correctly returning to control mode when a popup was displayed.
[*] Fixed monster movement issues causing them to get stuck in doors.
[/list]
[h3]UI & Navigation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed initialization issues with the input helper.
[*] Fixed localization issues (e.g., missing translations for "Shelf").
[*] Improved notification system: now includes queued messages and proper localization.
[*] Fixed header layout not updating correctly on the in-game tablet.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these improvements and fixes. Happy monster caring! 🐾✨

notes.title: Update 0.2 : Monsterpedia
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Here is update 0.2 of Monster Care Simulator! 
Changelog:

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*]:book: Monsterpedia:
[list]
[*]Introduced a new Monsterpedia in the tablet, featuring a short description, photo, and name for each monster.[/list]
[*]Monster Fighting:
[list]
[*]Monsters with very low happiness can now attack each other and knock out other monsters.
[*]Tip: Keep your monsters happy to prevent fights!
[/list]
[*]Monster Recovery Station:
[list]
[*]Recover monsters that have been knocked out using the recovery station.
[/list]
[*]Barriers:
[list]
[*] You can now use barriers to separate monsters in your garden.
[*] [Use barriers to isolate angry monsters before treating them.[/list]
[*] Audio:
[list]
[*] Added flute sound and note particles when monsters are dancing.
[/list][/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with monsters eating food from shelves.
[*]Fixed issue where shelf slots became unusable after food was eaten.
[*] Fixed monsters not noticing balls when loading a save.
[*] Monster Stings:
[list]
[*]Fixed invisible stuck items (they are now visible).
[*]Made the wound bigger for better visibility.
[/list]
[*] Frozen Monsters:
[list]
[*]  Fixed frozen monsters becoming unfreezable after sleeping in a bed or in the garden.[/list]
[*]Added a check to ensure monster names are always unique.
[*] Reworked collisions of small objects to prevent them from falling into the ground.
[*]Disabled healing particles in the garden when monster health is at 100%.
[/list]

We know that in this update, we introduced monster fights as a kind of consequence for having monsters with low happiness or being angry. But don’t worry! In the next updates, we’ll also be adding positive rewards for keeping your monsters happy and cheerful. 
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.1.10
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!
Here is a new update (0.1.10) with a batch of bug fixes and improvements

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[*] Better Shelf Interactions:
[list]
[*] Shelves have been completely reworked with specific slots to neatly place and retrieve items.
[*]You can now move shelves without worrying about items falling off—no more furniture chaos!
[/list]
[*]Game Balancing: Adjusted upgrade fees to improve the progression balance and make upgrades feel more rewarding.
[*]Pedestrian WIP: Early work has started on pedestrian behavior. More updates coming soon!
[*]Added more visual  and random variations to dirty and stung monsters.


[b]Visual & UI[/b]
[list]
[*] A new "Decoration" category has been added to tablet, making it easier to distinguish between gameplay-affecting furniture and purely decorative items.
[*] Tablet Improvements: Hovering over elements in the tablet now displays helpful descriptions, making it clearer what you’re about to buy.
[*] Monster Animations: Monsters can now blink—because even they need a little extra charm. :wink:
[/list]

[b]Fixes & Optimization[/b]
[*]Fixed garden wall issues that caused items and players to slide under it.
[*]Various smaller bug fixes and polish to improve gameplay and visuals.
[*]Fixed bug where 2 customers
Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates!

Have a great week end!

notes.title: Monster Care Simulator Playtest Update 0.1.9
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Pause Menu: When opening the pause menu, the game now fully pauses—the game and time of day no longer progresses.
[*] Fixed an issue causing monsters to spawn with ice or nails in the wrong positions; this should also resolve problems with older saves—please let us know if you run into any issues.
[*] Disabled collisions between customers that were causing them to get stuck in front of the store.
[*] Added extra security checks on physics objects to reduce the chance of them getting stuck in walls or flying high in the air.
[*] Implemented a ground test when placing furniture to ensure beds and other items cannot be stacked.
[*] Reworked the mouse sensitivity slider to make adjustments easier, especially at lower sensitivity settings.
[/list]
[*] [b]Visual & UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Separated volume controls into two independent sliders—one for music and one for sound effects.
[*] Adjusted the “Press Enter to finish the day” text to avoid overlapping HUD elements.
[*] Resolved various visual issues with LOD objects.
[*] Fixed localization issues.
[/list]
[*] [b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 100 new random pet-themed names.
[*] Fixed an issue where the aerosol noise from a healing spray continued until the can was dropped or trashed.
[*] Reworked monster behavior to prevent them from accumulating near the stairs.
[/list]
[/list]
